goal: Operationalize Human-by-Exception continuation using only authority already canonical before PIPE-WU-125, with deterministic escalation, WAIT, STOP and separate-authority behavior and no authority expansion.
scope: map existing control-loop classifications to deterministic Human-by-Exception handling without broadening any authority
continue automatically only when an already-canonical authority contract authorizes the exact action
surface OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED to the owner without mutation
preserve WAIT_ONLY as wait/no-replay and STOP_ONLY as terminal stop
preserve SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED as fail-closed until a separate governed authority exists
produce machine-verifiable control-plane evidence for the operationalization boundary
forbidden_scope: create or infer new provider-state, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
weaken owner escalation, runtime qualification, WAIT, STOP or no-replay semantics
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: automatic continuation is mechanically limited to existing explicit authority
OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY and SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED are preserved exactly
operationalization itself grants no new mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
